conditions: Traveling periodic wave component with positive wavelength and frequency measured in the same frame; v denotes phase-speed magnitude, not group speed.
spoken_aliases: wave speed equals frequency times wavelength

evidence: For a traveling periodic wave, a fixed phase advances one wavelength during one period T. Its phase-speed magnitude is lambda/T; with f=1/T this gives f lambda. It does not generally give group velocity in a dispersive medium.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/16-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
